articles.summary: Law360 reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer Travis Lenkner to Chief Operating Officer, expanding his role overseeing execution and operating performance across the business. The article also notes the promotion of Carrie Tendler to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery, as Burford continues to build out its senior leadership team. Learn more.
articles.title: Law360 reports Travis Lenkner's promotion to Chief Development Officer

articles.summary: On Semafor’s Compound Interest podcast, Burford CEO Chris Bogart discusses Burford's growth plans and the heightened focus on law firm equity. Learn more.
articles.title: Chris Bogart discusses structural change in law on Semafor’s Compound Interest podcast

articles.summary: Solicitors Journal reports that Travis Lenkner has been appointed Chief Operating Officer, where "he will be responsible for overseeing execution and operating performance across the firm's various business units." Learn more.
articles.title: Solicitors Journal reports on Travis Lenkner's appointment as Chief Operating Officer

articles.summary: Writing in New York Law Journal, Greg McPolin and Charles Griffin examine how healthcare organizations are approaching litigation strategy in a challenging financial environment. The article explores how legal finance can help providers pursue affirmative recoveries while preserving capital and maintaining focus on core operations. Learn more.
articles.title: New York Law Journal features Greg McPolin and Charles Griffin on litigation strategy in a capital-constrained healthcare market

articles.summary: Legal Business reports that Burford remains focused on growth and diversification following the Second Circuit’s YPF decision. The article highlights Christopher Bogart’s comments on the strength of Burford’s business and emerging opportunities in areas including law firm equity investments and managed services organization (MSO) structures. Learn more.
articles.title: Legal Business reports on Burford’s growth plans

articles.summary: CDR reports that Burford Capital has promoted Chief Development Officer Travis Lenkner to Chief Operating Officer and elevated Special Counsel Carrie Tendler to Managing Director and Head of Asset Recovery. CEO Christopher Bogart says the pair “have quickly established themselves as strong business leaders,” as Burford continues to expand its leadership bench across key areas of the business. Learn more.
articles.title: Burford promotes Travis Lenkner and Carrie Tendler, reports CDR

articles.summary: Corporate legal departments are facing mounting litigation risk and rising legal costs across industries and jurisdictions. Discover how businesses are rethinking litigation funding and dispute management to navigate growing financial and operational pressures.
articles.title: Litigation costs are soaring, legal finance is becoming a corporate necessity

articles.summary: Geopolitical disruption is straining supply chains and contract performance across energy, industry and construction. Disputes are shifting toward mitigation, allocation decisions and specific contractual failures. Read more.
articles.title: Energy, derivatives and construction disputes: Managing risk from supply disruption

articles.summary: The Times comments on CEO Chris Bogart’s recent comments following the YPF decision. As reported: “Christopher Bogart, the Burford chief executive, told reporters in London this week that, because the company had sold a stake in the two-part litigation, [it] hard turned a handy profit," while also predicting the claim would ultimately be resolved via arbitration. Learn more.
articles.title: The Times reports on Chris Bogart's comments regarding the YPF decision

articles.summary: GAR recently covered an event in London featuring Burford Capital CEO Christopher Bogart and arbitrator Jacomijn van Haersolte-van Hof, former director general of the LCIA. The discussion explored how arbitral institutions and legal finance providers approach arbitrator appointments, alongside broader appointment-related issues and practical ways to promote efficiency in arbitral proceedings. Learn more.
articles.title: GAR covers arbitration event with Chris Bogart and Jacomijn van Haersolte-van Hof

articles.summary: Spain is emerging as an increasingly attractive market for litigation finance, driven by its growing role as an arbitration hub and rising demand for alternative legal funding solutions. In an interview with El Confidencial, Burford CEO Christopher Bogart and Madrid-based Senior Vice President Teresa Gutiérrez Chacón discuss the evolution of the market and the significant opportunities they see ahead. Learn more.
articles.title: Spain’s litigation finance market gains momentum, reports El Confidencial

articles.summary: InvestmentNews reports that litigation finance is becoming more accessible to registered investment advisors through alternative investment platforms such as SEI Access. The article explores how advisors are evaluating litigation finance as a differentiated, non-market-correlated asset class, while noting that broader adoption remains driven by education, due diligence and familiarity with the sector.
